dataset: DWD daily weather, station 00433
usable_for: Weather covariates for aligned daily panels.
limitation: Rainfall missing on two days; station is a city weather proxy. Weather adjustment alone does not resolve treatment confounding.
next_requirement: Join only after spatial treatment and timing are established.

dataset: Official bicycle workbook with provider quality flags
coverage: 2019–2020; 26 directional counters; 19,006 counter-days
usable_for: Quality-aware cycling baseline and seasonal comparison.
limitation: 46,793 provider-flagged zero/implausible cells and 80 other missing cells. Naive clock labels require DST audit. Existing counters are not on the three verified project screenlines.
next_requirement: Obtain counters at treated boundaries and comparable untreated sites.

dataset: Official hourly motor detection archive
rows: 4,532,392 hourly records; 190,837 published section-days; 309,085 candidate-road hours
coverage: 2019-01-01–2020-12-31; 24 monthly archives; 267 cross-sections
usable_for: Pre-period, road volumes, point speeds and comparison-road candidates. Attribution: Digitale Plattform Stadtverkehr Berlin / Verkehrsdetektion Berlin.
limitation: Vehicles are not people; road-name candidate assignment is unverified. Missing full-source dates 2019-06-03 and 2019-09-10. Point speed is not complete journey time.
next_requirement: Verify historical treatment geometry, same-screenline bike counters and occupancy/passenger data.

dataset: Official project pages and current infrastructure geometry
rows: 3 verified pop-up project geometries plus detector-proximity audit
coverage: 2020 project documents; current mapped geometry
usable_for: Treatment-location screening and identification of missing screenline coverage.
limitation: Current shapes do not establish all historical lane configurations. Nearest bicycle counters are about 1.55–1.97 km from these three shapes.
next_requirement: Confirm dated as-built lane changes and match each sensor to its actual intervention.

dataset: Historical Bluetooth road-speed observations
coverage: 2020 intervention period discussed in the paper
usable_for: Potential road-speed panel
limitation: The source and published study were located; underlying historical observations and a complete replication have not been acquired.
next_requirement: Obtain dated link-level observations and treatment mapping.

dataset: Downtown cordon site-level passenger, pedestrian and bicycle totals
coverage: 2016–2019: 31, 31, 31 and 30 site-year records; one survey day per location.
usable_for: Person counts by direction, with car occupants, transit occupants, walking and cycling, at a downtown boundary.
limitation: Annual site summaries, not individual observations. Different sites surveyed on different days. Missing fields retained. Network and economic changes, weather and construction confound before/after comparisons.
next_requirement: Consistent boundary/site accounting, exact date alignment and untreated-city comparison.

dataset: Eight official annual downtown cordon summary workbooks
coverage: 2012–2019; 06:00–22:00 daily measurement window.
usable_for: Longer pre-period and post-period occupants/active-mode totals, including Calgary Transit. Official 2017 method includes C-Train and bus passengers.
limitation: 2012–2015 API exports contain location inventories only; counts are in downloaded workbook attachments. Occupant subtotals, vehicle totals and active counts have different definitions. Multi-week fieldwork is not one simultaneous day; no bike-lane causal attribution.
next_requirement: Check changing cordon locations/methods and compare against employment, weather and control cities.

dataset: Daily pedestrian count extract
coverage: 2021-2022; acquired daily table
usable_for: Candidate walking outcome and coverage screening.
limitation: Not yet aligned to the exact project screenline and observation windows.
next_requirement: Confirm geography, directional definition and coverage before adding to person flow.

dataset: MBTA actual bus arrival/departure events
coverage: November and December 2021; May 2022; seven selected routes
usable_for: Route 77 same-date segment runtimes; comparison route candidates.
limitation: Provisional pairing retained 1,038 Route 77 runs, but the derived comparisons are withheld pending timezone/coverage audit; directions have different segment boundaries. Segment time excludes access, wait, transfer and other journey legs.
next_requirement: Longer pre/post and calibrated comparator analysis; resolve treatment package and missing/invalid events.

dataset: MBTA seasonal automatic passenger count loads
usable_for: Stop-level boardings, alightings, average onboard load and sample sizes.
limitation: Seasonal average trip/stop loads do not supply exact November/December 2021 passenger counts.
next_requirement: Acquire aligned APC days or explicitly model season/day mismatch and its uncertainty.

dataset: Miovision 15-minute movement/class records
coverage: Source-clock dates May 1-14, 2021 and 2022; November 2-4 and December 14-16, 2021; three requested intersections
usable_for: Bicycle and motor vehicle detections at a candidate project boundary, with candidate comparisons; source-clock windows only.
limitation: Timebin appears UTC (identifier carries Z), while other series use service dates; local-day/peak alignment is unresolved. Garden/Huron is missing in May 2022; November/December has only three source-clock days per period. Boundary mapping is inferred; counts are detections, not unique journeys.
next_requirement: Verify detector direction/calibration and longer balanced coverage, then weather and treatment/control validity.

dataset: Nørrebrogade bus and bicycle time tables
coverage: 2008 trial evaluation
usable_for: Reconstruct reported route-period means
limitation: Not individual bus GPS records or passenger counts; one source arithmetic discrepancy is explicitly corrected.
next_requirement: Obtain vehicle run records, passenger loads and aligned control corridors.

dataset: Fifth Street original count and travel-time observations
coverage: 2014 conversion evaluation
usable_for: Potential count and road-time replication
limitation: Published summaries are available; original observations and a clean comparison group have not been acquired.
next_requirement: Acquire underlying counts, timed runs and occupancy data.

dataset: Historical LCAP / TrafficMaster archive listings
coverage: Public archive listings inspected; LCAP listings begin in 2018
usable_for: Potential later road travel-time coverage.
limitation: No 2016 matched baseline or analytic journey-time series acquired in this pass.
next_requirement: Acquire pre-opening and post-opening link observations with metadata and common coverage.

dataset: TfL Active Travel Counts Programme raw survey waves
coverage: 23 Central/Cycleways files, 2014-2017; 2,176 location metadata rows
usable_for: 16 quarterly bicycle profiles around Blackfriars/Embankment, private versus hire cycles, comparison sites; selected motor-mode surveys.
limitation: A wave can assemble time bins across dates. Bike profiles and Cycleways motor counts are not automatically a common screenline. Rows are survey cells, not people or independent days.
next_requirement: Verify lane conversion dates and boundaries; recover matched passenger occupancy and total journey times.

dataset: Underlying data for published total-person-flow claim
coverage: Published evaluation claim; underlying matched count/occupancy calculation not acquired
usable_for: Prior reported result remains a secondary comparison, separate from downloaded observations.
limitation: New bicycle survey data do not independently reproduce total people or the reported percentage.
next_requirement: Acquire original before/after count and occupancy worksheets.

dataset: Oxford Road evaluation tables
coverage: Before/after dates vary by mode and site
usable_for: Reconstruct published bicycle, bus and road-time comparisons
limitation: Underlying GPS runs, passenger loads and individual survey records have not been acquired; policy includes bus and access changes.
next_requirement: Acquire original observation files and consistent comparator records.

dataset: Underlying GPS travel-time trajectories
coverage: Published scheme evaluation only
usable_for: Published report remains usable as a labelled summary.
limitation: Underlying GPS records and sampling frame not acquired.
next_requirement: Obtain source trajectories or link-time panel and comparison design.

dataset: Historical annual cycling archives and Rivoli/Voltaire extraction
coverage: Five annual archives, 2016–2020; per-counter coverage in download
usable_for: Historical cycling observations, detector continuity and possible pre-period screening.
limitation: Rivoli device changes from 158 rue de Rivoli in 2016–2017 to Totem 64 in 2019–2020; no Rivoli records in 2018 archive. Voltaire 2018 coverage is partial. Do not splice devices blindly.
next_requirement: Verify stable same-location observation windows, construction chronology and untreated comparators.

dataset: Historical road-count archives, with bounded corridor extract
rows: 5 annual ZIP archives acquired; 19,488 selected arc-hour rows published
coverage: 2016–2020 archives downloaded; published extract May 1–8 and June 1–8, 2020
usable_for: Accessible pre/post road archive and raw vehicle observations for a future aligned panel.
limitation: Full five-year road panel is not yet harmonized. q counts vehicles; k is detector occupancy, not passengers. Serial arcs double-count trips; sampled weeks are confounded by COVID restrictions.
next_requirement: Extract a continuous stable-detector panel, verify lane geometry, passenger occupancy and comparison roads.

dataset: IDFM historical rail validation catalog
rows: Catalog metadata acquired; passenger records not yet downloaded
coverage: Historical annual download catalog
usable_for: Identifies potentially useful station-entry time series.
limitation: Catalog rows are not passenger observations. Station entries do not measure onboard loads across a study boundary or complete journeys.
next_requirement: Acquire station-level files and determine whether a suitable boundary load estimate is possible.

dataset: Fremont Bridge hourly bike counts
usable_for: Counter-level trends and coverage assessment.
limitation: Potential comparator only; different corridor, network spillovers and demand trends need testing. Duplicate timestamp rows: 0.
next_requirement: Align treatment dates and physical boundary; resolve duplicates and test comparators.

dataset: Second Avenue / West Marginal motor study hour bins
coverage: Study-specific multi-year snapshots; selected named corridors
usable_for: Candidate vehicle volumes with study metadata.
limitation: Snapshot studies are not a continuous matched passenger series; corridor-name selection is not verified treatment assignment.
next_requirement: Verify exact site, dates, direction, occupancy and overlap with bike counters.

dataset: Second Avenue hourly bike counts
usable_for: Counter-level trends and coverage assessment.
limitation: No 2014 pre-intervention observations returned; cannot estimate the 2014 effect from this extract. Duplicate timestamp rows: 0.
next_requirement: Align treatment dates and physical boundary; resolve duplicates and test comparators.

dataset: Spokane Street bridge hourly bike counts
usable_for: Counter-level trends and coverage assessment.
limitation: Not the West Marginal treatment screenline; duplicate date/time records retained and flagged. Duplicate timestamp rows: 0.
next_requirement: Align treatment dates and physical boundary; resolve duplicates and test comparators.

dataset: George Street traveler panel diaries
coverage: Published panel study
usable_for: A design for measuring journeys across modes
limitation: Raw diaries have not been acquired; moving-lane conversion eligibility remains unverified.
next_requirement: Verify lane geometry and lawful availability of de-identified panel data.

dataset: Bloor, Dupont and Harbord intersection turning-movement observations
coverage: 2013-03-13–2019-07-17; 108 count surveys at 49 named intersections, 32 quarter-hours per survey.
usable_for: Cars/trucks/buses by turning movement plus bike and pedestrian approaches, with candidate comparison streets.
limitation: This is a geographic query of public TMC data, not the original Bloor pilot matched 11-location video dataset. Repeated adjacent intersections must not be summed as unique people. No occupancy or travel times.
next_requirement: Verify intervention boundaries, survey dates, observation windows and comparable controls before estimation.

dataset: 2008 False Creek bridge classification, occupancy, bikes, pedestrians and bus passenger tables
coverage: Fall 2008, one weekday per site; observed 06–09, 11–13 and 15–19; 16-hour motor totals include interpolation.
usable_for: Observed occupancy and transit passenger baseline on Burrard, Granville and Cambie.
limitation: Published tables, not the underlying 15-minute database. Exact survey dates absent. Motorised person totals exclude active modes. Nine-hour active/transit counts cannot be added to 16-hour road totals.
next_requirement: Dated original survey database and matching 2009 passenger measurements.

dataset: 2011 False Creek bridges and Canada Line passenger tables
rows: 3 bridge summaries; 2 transit context rows; 12 metric comparisons
coverage: Single weekday per site, mid-September to mid-December 2011; report published 2013.
usable_for: Before/after comparisons with the same nine-hour period definition; bridge occupancy and new rail alternative.
limitation: Days/weather are unmatched; transit totals rounded. Canada Line opening, bus restructuring and construction changes confound any bike-lane attribution. No complete journey times.
next_requirement: Exact survey dates, unrounded records and credible comparison crossings.

dataset: Burrard Bridge daily directional bicycles, pedestrians and motor vehicles (re-downloaded previous acquisition)
coverage: 2009-06-01–2010-12-31; bicycle totals valid on 562 days, pedestrian totals 548, vehicle totals 523.
usable_for: Observed bridge counts and existing short-run same-weekday descriptive comparisons
limitation: Previously acquired; this is a fresh copy of the same export. Passenger loads absent; bike/pedestrian baseline is short and missing values are present.
next_requirement: Occupancy and transit loads on matching dates, Ontario/other-crossing controls and weather.

dataset: Daily bicycle volumes: Burrard Bridge, Hornby Street, Dunsmuir Street, Dunsmuir Viaduct
coverage: 2009-07-01–2012-03-31. Non-null rows: Burrard 999 from 2009-07-01; Hornby 414 from 2011-01-25; Dunsmuir Street 618 from 2010-06-08; Dunsmuir Viaduct 759 from 2010-03-04.
usable_for: Longer observed bicycle history, later downtown network interventions and count quality audit.
limitation: Contains no Ontario, Granville, Cambie, motor vehicles, pedestrians or passenger loads. One of 547 overlapping Burrard dates disagrees: 2010-06-29 is 40,358 versus 4,420 in original export. Both retained. Later lanes are not untreated controls.
next_requirement: Resolve anomalous record with publisher; obtain independent comparison series.

dataset: Directional traffic count location inventory (not observations)
coverage: 6,680 location geometry records; no counts, dates or data links in export.
usable_for: Identify bridge and Ontario count-location geometry.
limitation: Location inventory only; no Granville/Cambie observations acquired through this export.
next_requirement: Underlying hourly/daily permanent-counter records with station identifiers.

dataset: Granville/Cambie daily crossing counts aligned to Burrard 2009
coverage: Desired daily series 2008–2010; not acquired.
usable_for: Potential spillover outcomes; not automatically untreated controls.
limitation: City traffic-data page directs access to VanMap. Linked app returned HTTP 403 and web reader could not fetch. Catalog exports have locations only; historical app coverage unverified.
next_requirement: Accessible historical counter export. Separate 2008/2011 screenline tables supply sparse alternatives.

dataset: Intersection traffic movement count location inventory (not observations)
coverage: 659 location records, with no observation-date or count fields. Includes Cambie Bridge/W 2nd Avenue and Granville Bridge/Drake Street links.
usable_for: Locate count reports and map possible crossing/approach observation sites.
limitation: Inventory contains names, geometry and links only. It is not downloaded traffic observations. Linked app returned HTTP 403; web-reader fetch also failed.
next_requirement: Accessible VanMap count-report/API export with dates and directional classified counts.

dataset: Ontario Bike Route daily comparison counts and fitted Burrard counterfactual
coverage: Desired period 2008–2010. Metadata confirms Ontario comparison was used, but export contains only Burrard counts.
usable_for: Confirms existence of original comparison method; cannot yet reproduce its counterfactual.
limitation: Official catalog query for Ontario returns one dataset: Burrard metadata. No Ontario series, expected daily values, fitted parameters or training window found in inspected public sources. Saved metadata is not comparison data.
next_requirement: Original Ontario counter file and fitted model/export from City transportation-data archive.

dataset: Original screenline survey database and 2009 Burrard bus times/passenger loads
coverage: Desired: original 2008/2011 surveys and 2009 trial-period APC/AVL.
usable_for: Would align survey dates, intervals, vehicle classes and passenger loads.
limitation: Reports describe underlying databases; no public raw database was acquired. The 2009 bus-time finding is only a qualitative published summary.
next_requirement: Agency archive or original data access; no request sent.
